Glass Insulator Lot - 3 Pieces
Hemingray and American Manufactured
Aqua Teal and Clear, Vintage Mid-Century Era
This collection of three vintage glass insulators represents a significant era in American telecommunications history. Used primarily to insulate telegraph and telephone wires from their wooden support poles, these heavy glass pieces are prized by collectors for their industrial aesthetic and vibrant glass colors. This lot provides a balanced display including a classic aqua teal piece and two clear glass specimens.
Pieces Included:
Hemingray Insulator, Aqua Teal Glass, embossed "HEMINGRAY" with beaded drip points - minor base fleabites
Clear Glass Insulator, embossed "MADE IN U.S.A.", smooth base - excellent vintage condition
Unmarked Clear Glass Insulator, smooth base - excellent vintage condition

The clear insulators are notably well-preserved with no significant chips or cracks. All pieces retain their original glossy transparency without signs of glass disease or mineral cloudiness.

description:
Pressed Glass Insulator Lot - 12 Pieces
Whitall Tatum, Armstrong, and Pyrex
Aqua, Clear, and Smoky, Vintage 1920s-1950s
This collection features twelve vintage glass telephone and telegraph insulators from prominent American manufacturers. These pieces represent a significant era in telecommunications history, showcasing various industrial glass formulas including standard aqua, clear, and heat-resistant Pyrex borosilicate glass. Matching sets and mixed lots from these manufacturers are highly collectible for their industrial aesthetic and historical utility.
Pieces Included:
Whitall Tatum Co. No. 1, Aqua Glass - characteristic greenish-blue tint, molded manufacturer marks on base
Pyrex Clear Glass Insulator - high-clarity borosilicate glass, marked "Pyrex Reg. U.S. Pat. Off."
Armstrong "W" in Triangle Mark, Aqua Glass - produced after Armstrong's 1938 acquisition of Whitall Tatum
Armstrong T.W. Smoky/Clear Glass - industrial clear glass with age-appropriate tinting and molded date codes
Additional assorted aqua and clear pressed glass insulators to complete the 12-piece set
Condition:
The lot is in good vintage condition consistent with outdoor industrial use. Several pieces show characteristic rust staining near the thread interior and top grooves from contact with metal mounting brackets. No significant structural cracks observed. Minor fleabites and surface scratches may be present on rims or skirts. All molded lettering remains legible.

description:
Sheaffer
Lady Sheaffer Fountain Pen - Gold-Tone Brushed Finish
Vintage (Circa 1958-1960s), 1 Pen with Case
This Lady Sheaffer fountain pen represents the intersection of mid-century fashion and high-quality craftsmanship from one of America's most prestigious pen manufacturers. Part of the "Skripsert" line launched in the late 1950s, these pens were designed specifically as stylish accessories for women, often featuring clip-less designs or refined jewelry-like finishes. This specific example features a sophisticated brushed gold-tone finish complemented by an intricate, ornate engraved band on the cap, showcasing the brand's commitment to both utility and style during the peak of fountain pen production.
"Lady Sheaffer" branding clearly visible on the interior lid of the original case
Distinctive brushed metal body with an ornate floral scroll engraved band on the cap
Includes original blue textured hard shell case with satin-lined interior
Accompanied by the internal metal cartridge sleeve/converter housing
Condition:
Good vintage condition. The brushed metal finish shows light age-appropriate surface wear and minor tarnish consistent with use. The ornate cap band remains well-defined. The nib is present and appears straight, though the pen is currently untested for ink flow. The original case shows light exterior wear and storage dust; the hinge functions correctly and the interior lining is intact.

Mixed Stone Projectile Points

This collection of sixteen projectile points features a diverse range of lithic materials and knapping styles. Also included is a Middle Eastern-style wooden desktop organizer with intricate inlaid patterns in green, gold, and black, brass pen holders, a letter holder, and a small front drawer. The bottom of the organizer has a wood finish with felt pads. This set is suited for collectors or those interested in fraternal organization memorabilia.

description:
Vesuvio Minerali Naturali Mineral Rock Collection Set in Wooden Display Case
Vesuvio 'Minerali Naturali' natural mineral and rock collection set housed in a wooden display case. Includes labeled volcanic minerals and stones from Mount Vesuvius such as olivine, granite, sulfur, silvestrite, calcite, pyrite, quartz, amethyst, obsidian, and more. description:
Natural Specimen
Quartz Geode Crystal Cluster
Mineral on Green Host Rock Matrix
Approximately 3.5" x 2.5" x 2"
Unsigned
This striking natural geode specimen features a cavity of sparkling clear quartz crystals nestled within a vibrant, teal-green host rock matrix. The exterior coloration suggests the presence of copper-bearing minerals such as chrysocolla or malachite, providing a dramatic visual contrast to the prismatic crystalline interior. This piece serves as a sophisticated organic accent, showcasing the raw geological beauty and complex textures found in natural mineral formations.
Features a well-defined interior cavity lined with translucent quartz crystal clusters
Natural green and turquoise-toned host rock with earthy iron-oxide inclusions on the reverse
Unique asymmetrical form suitable for shelf, desk, or cabinet display
Condition:
Excellent natural condition. As a raw geological specimen, it retains its original jagged edges and characteristic surface variations. The crystal points appear well-preserved within the cavity, and the surrounding matrix is stable with minor natural surface wear typical of extracted mineral specimens.

description: Lot of natural raw geode stones featuring mineral specimens with quartz-like druzy crystal formations inside cavities. Specimens vary in size, with the largest approximately 9 cm and the smallest around 5 cm. Exterior surfaces are rough and earthy, while interiors display fine crystalline structures in tan, beige, and white hues. Unpolished and in natural condition. Suitable for collectors, educational purposes, or display. See photos for condition.

description:
Mixed Natural Mineral and Rock Specimens Lot Quartz Calcite Chert Flint
This lot contains unpolished natural mineral and rock specimens suitable for collectors, educational use, or lapidary projects. Included are a large white quartz crystal, multiple pieces of brownish chert or flint, a yellow calcite crystal, and assorted tumbled and rough stones of various sizes and colors. The specimens are in raw, unprocessed condition with natural fractures and rough edges visible. The rocks range from small pebbles to larger hand-sized pieces. The lot is contained in a clear plastic container for easy sorting and examination. No brand or model is associated.

.

description:
Cross
Classic Century Pen and Pencil Set - Lustrous Chrome
Vintage 1980s, Ribbed Pinstripe Design
This Cross Classic Century set features the slim, elegant silhouette that has defined the brand's professional writing instruments for decades. Crafted in polished chrome with a distinctive vertical pinstripe texture, this set represents the mid-century modern aesthetic that transitioned into a timeless corporate standard. Both pieces feature the signature conical top and twist-action mechanism that are hallmarks of American precision manufacturing.
Polished chrome finish with vertical ribbed pinstripe engraving
Includes original ballpoint pen and matching mechanical pencil
Authentic "Cross Made in USA" stamps on crowns and brand logo on clips
Personalized engravings: "Mrs. Harmon 88" and "To a Special Teacher 88"
Condition:
Excellent vintage condition with minimal signs of surface wear to the chrome finish. The original presentation box is included and is in good structural condition with minor storage wear. The set includes the original guarantee and instruction booklet.
POLICIES and Seller Info
How to reach us-
Per the policies of our selling location, we do not remove unpaid items or cancel bids. Thank you for understanding!
Sending a message via shopgoodwill.com message is the only way to reach us and receive a response. Your concerns are very important to us, but we do not have a business phone on site. Calls to the home office cannot be transferred to us, so if you call and leave a message, you are guaranteed NOT to receive a response and we don't want that! Customer services messages are checked throughout the day, Monday through Friday (excluding holidays), between the hours of 9am and 4pm eastern time.
Domestic Shipping-
Items with a Fixed/Flat shipping fee (rather than calculated) will ship the cheapest possible way, FedEx shipping is not guaranteed on items with a fixed shipping cost. FedEx does not ship to P.O. boxes or APO/FPO addresses. Please enter an address that we can ship to at check out.
Your package will be insured, regardless of mail class or carrier, however, insurance DOES NOT cover theft after delivery. Porch piracy is very common so we strongly suggest that you use your DAYTIME address you will be available to receive your package. If you require a specific carrier, signature confirmation, or have a special packing/handling request, please make your needs known by clicking Contact Seller prior to making payment so that we can add applicable fees for service(s) requested. We have accounts with FedEx and USPS only.
Handling-
Items like instruments, artwork, delicate collectibles, stereo receivers, and sewing machines require additional packing materials and labor to pack them safely. For this reason, handling fees are higher on specialty items.
Handling fees cap at $15 on combined orders. So if you combine 10 items with a $2 each handling fee, the system will automatically discount your shipping price and your handling would be $15 rather than $20. (This applies to items combined from Chattanooga Area Goodwill only).

We typically do not authorize returns, so it is VERY important that you read the full description, carefully view all photos, and ask any questions you may have PRIOR to placing bids. Pictures are considered a part of the item description. Any item returned without prior authorization from the seller will be considered a donation and re-sold.
Special Disclaimers (
whenever applicable
)-
Our Presidium Gem Tester is able to identify the gemstone family or families based on the hardness of the tested gem. We are not certified gemologists, so we are not always able to determine the specific gemstone(s) present, differentiate between certain stones, or confirm the device's findings.
Most of the world's pearls are cultured. The ability to differentiate between cultured, freshwater, and natural (ocean) pearls is beyond the scope of our equipment.
Unless otherwise stated above, all marked metals are tested by our Thermo Scientific Niton DXL Precious Metal Analyzer. Photos will be provided in listing of results. If not, a precious metal it will be listed and Gold/Silver Tone or plated.
Some listings may contain a mixture of fine jewelry AND costume jewelry. Please read full description to understand what you are buying. Items described as costume jewelry are presumed to not include precious metals, regardless of any markings you may see in photos.
Local Pick Up-
